```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
Sys.setenv(VALIDATION_CALIBRATION_ROOT = normalizePath(params$root, mustWork = TRUE))
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "00_paths.R"))
activate_local_lib()
source_vc("05_report_helpers.R")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
profile <- params$profile
split <- read_validation_table("validation_split_stability", profile)
```

# Split Stability Metrics

```{r}
tab <- split |>
  arrange(scenario_family, n, group, direction) |>
  select(
    scenario_family, n, within_r, between_r, group, direction,
    split_count, estimable_split_count, retention_rate,
    p_value_cv, p_value_iqr, p_value_min, p_value_max,
    positive_sign_rate, negative_sign_rate, rejection_rate
  )
kable_if_rows(tab, "Repeated split stability")
```

```{r fig.height=5, fig.width=8}
plot_data <- split |>
  mutate(setting = paste0(scenario_family, ", n=", n))
safe_rate_plot(plot_data, "setting", "p_value_cv",
               title = "Validation p-value coefficient of variation")
```
